name: 獎金 (bonus)
authority: 健保法 §31(1): a bonus from the employer counts toward the supplementary premium above four times the insured amount; 所得稅法 §14: taxable salary income.

name: 資遣費 (severance pay)
authority: 勞退條例 §12(1): a worker under the new pension system dismissed under 勞基法 §11, §13 proviso or §14 is paid half a month’s average wage for every year of service, pro rata for a part year, up to six months’ wages. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): 勞退條例 §12 / 勞基法 §11, §17: severance is owed on a termination by the employer under §11 (redundancy; `exit_reason == "REDUNDANCY"`); a fixed-term contract that ends on its date owes none (§18).
